_meta.phase: 2 — flow scenario enumeration (actor x entry-state x branch)
_meta.note: Every actor below is a real reachable combination of fields read out of lib/app/app_state.dart, lib/router/app_router.dart, lib/data/api/auth_token_store.dart, lib/data/api/passcode_store.dart, lib/screens/onboarding/log_in_screen.dart and lib/screens/onboarding/otp_screen.dart. Unreachable combinations are marked reachable:false with the mechanical reason in evidence.

fields.pendingSignupEmail: set after sign-up, before OTP verify

actors.evidence: lib/screens/onboarding/otp_screen.dart:135 (AuthTokenStore.saveTokens runs immediately on OTP verify, before suitability/risk-disclaimer/terms/passcode ever run) + lib/app/app_state.dart:415-434 (_hydrateSignedIn sets signedIn=true from the token ALONE on the next cold start, no passcode check) + lib/app/app_state.dart:520 (_gateRedirect's cold-start unlock force requires passcodeSet==true, so it does not fire here)
actors.note: This is a genuine, currently-open composition defect — see composition-findings.md item 1. The app killed anywhere between a successful OTP verify and a successful passcode confirm produces exactly this actor on the next cold start.

Reachable only as a BLOCKED login attempt per the backend contract cited in the client's own comment (log_in_screen.dart's header references dormancy being the one lifecycle check login doesn't block on, implying suspended is blocked at login) — never as a live signed-in AppState combination. Could not confirm the client-side handling of the login rejection shape for this case from lib/ alone; see composition-findings.md bonus finding for what the client does and does not do with a live accountStatus:'suspended' push.

actors.evidence: lib/main.dart:148 (`if (!_state.signedIn || !_state.passcodeSet) return;` — resume-lock is a silent no-op for exactly the actor above, interrupted_onboarding_signed_in_no_passcode, if it is ever resumed from background instead of cold-started)
actors.note: Same underlying gap as interrupted_onboarding_signed_in_no_passcode, reached via the resume entry-state instead of cold start.

rows.capability: a guest with no token on this device is dropped on the Welcome/Sign-up path rather than Home
rows.expected: splash routes to welcome (no passcode set) per splash_screen.dart:81

rows.capability: a user who just signed up can verify the emailed OTP and move on to the suitability questionnaire
rows.expected: tokens saved, AppState.pendingSignupEmail set, routes to Routes.questionnaire (otp_screen.dart:134-144)

rows.capability: a user who types a wrong OTP code sees why and can retry without losing their place
a user verifying OTP with no network sees a clear failure, not a stuck spinner
rows.expected: ApiException (network) caught the same as any other ApiException; unclear whether raw DioException/timeout is also caught here — otp_screen.dart:145 catches ApiException only, no widened catch like bvn_nin.dart:199 has
rows.status: unclear — needs a live offline run to confirm ApiClient normalizes every transport failure into ApiException before this screen sees it

rows.capability: none — this is the defect. A user who was killed mid-onboarding (after OTP verify, before confirming a passcode) reopens the app and is dropped straight onto Home, fully free-roaming the signed-in app shell, with no local passcode, no biometric enrolment, and never having seen suitability/risk-disclosure/terms
rows.expected: should resume onboarding exactly where it left off (questionnaire/risk-disclaimer/terms/create-passcode), or at minimum force local passcode creation before any Home render
rows.actual: lib/router/app_router.dart:494-499,520-524 — preAuthOnly.contains('/splash') and '/welcome' both redirect signed-in users straight to Routes.home; the cold-start unlock force at line 520 is gated on passcodeSet==true so it never engages for this actor

rows.capability: a returning investor with a passcode on this device is forced through a real local unlock before anything else renders, even if they land on Home via a stale deep link
a user who mistypes their passcode is told it's wrong and can retry, without being signed out
rows.expected: log_in_screen.dart:336-347 sets _error, clears _code, stays on screen

rows.capability: a user who unlocks with the correct local passcode while offline still gets into the app (local check doesn't require network)
rows.expected: log_in_screen.dart:351-369 — a transient/network failure on the confirmatory GET /users/me falls through to unlock anyway, per its own comment ('don't lock a returning user out over a transient error')

rows.capability: a real account holder on a brand-new device can sign in with email+password and is walked into creating this device's first local passcode
a user who enters a wrong password sees the server's real error message
an account with step-up auth enabled is challenged with an emailed OTP before a session is issued
a user whose BVN/NIN fails the registry check (a real mismatch, not merely unresolved) is blocked from proceeding and told to fix the numbers, even though the backend call itself returned HTTP 200
rows.expected: bvn_nin.dart:136-149 routes to _Step.failed on verificationSignals.bvn/nin == false
rows.status: pass — this is the composition check #3 case and it holds; see composition-findings.md item 3

rows.capability: a user who left KYC mid-way and reopens the app can tap Home's prompt and resume at the right step instead of restarting from step 1
rows.expected: app_state.dart:588-617 always routes to Routes.kycIntro first (never straight to a step screen) so kyc_intro.dart can re-fetch the draft id

rows.capability: a rejected applicant sees a hard-wall outcome message distinct from 'still under review', with no retry path
a rejected applicant who still has resubmission attempts left sees that distinctly from a hard rejection
a flagged account is told it needs manual review and will be notified, not shown the generic pending-review copy
an account whose KYC submission expired is told to verify again, not left on a stale 'under review' state
a KYC-approved investor who has not taken the suitability questionnaire is stopped at the Buy/Sell/Add-money/Withdraw entry points and sent to the questionnaire, not allowed to place an order
rows.expected: app_state.dart:661-666 (tradingEligibilityGap), enforced also server-side per its own doc comment (app_state.dart:579-580)

rows.capability: an investor who completed suitability but never accepted the statutory risk disclosure is sent to accept it before trading
a fully eligible investor can open the Buy sheet with no interstitial gate at all
an account idle 12+ months is routed to the Dormant account screen on login instead of Home, even though login itself still succeeds
if the dormancy check's own network call fails, the investor still lands somewhere usable (Home) rather than being stuck
rows.expected: log_in_screen.dart:845-854 falls through to Home on ApiException

rows.capability: a suspended account cannot sign in and is told why
rows.expected: unclear from lib/ alone — could not find client-side handling of a suspended-specific login rejection distinct from a generic wrong-password error; see composition-findings.md

rows.capability: a user can freeze their own account and is told it is irreversible except via support
immediately after freezing, the same still-open app session is kicked out rather than continuing to show a live-looking Home screen
rows.expected: freeze revokes every session server-side per freeze_account_screen.dart:5-7; relies on the NEXT api_client.dart 401 -> onSessionExpired -> AppState.forceSignOut() (main.dart:55) — not an immediate local push; a user who freezes and then sits idle on a cached screen may see stale 'live' data until the next network call 401s
rows.status: unclear — needs a live run to see how long a frozen session's UI stays looking normal before the next call 401s

rows.capability: a signed-in investor who backgrounds the app for 30+ seconds is challenged with the passcode/biometric lock on return, without losing their place in the app
rows.expected: main.dart:133-159 pushes Routes.login(extra:true); pops back to the same screen on success (log_in_screen.dart:372-380)

rows.capability: a quick app-switch under 30 seconds does not re-challenge the investor

none — this is the same defect as interrupted_onboarding_signed_in_no_passcode, reached via resume instead of cold start: a signed-in investor with no local passcode who backgrounds and resumes the app is NEVER challenged at all, no matter how long the app sat backgrounded
rows.expected: should still force some re-authentication (there is no local secret to challenge with, so this should route to the email+password re-auth, not silently do nothing)
rows.actual: main.dart:148 returns silently whenever passcodeSet is false

rows.capability: an already signed-in investor can change their local passcode from Security and land back on Security with a confirmation, without being routed through onboarding
rows.expected: confirm_passcode_screen.dart:146-155 pops twice back to Security

rows.capability: a signed-out user who deep-links straight into a tab-shell/pushed-detail route is bounced to splash, never shown the gated content

a signed-in investor who navigates browser-back (web) or hits a stray stack entry into a pre-auth-only screen (splash/welcome/signup/otp/reset) is bounced forward to Home instead of being shown a pre-auth screen while already signed in
